visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor setting with a young woman standing before a floor-to-ceiling window. She has long brown hair and wears a white fluffy earmuff headband and a black bikini top. Outside, a snowy mountain landscape is visible under bright sunlight. (2) Outdoor snowy environment where two young women in ski gear take a selfie video. One wears a pink jacket and white goggles; the other wears a black jacket and iridescent goggles. They wave at the camera while background skiers are visible. (3) Two women hold large glass mugs filled with beer in an indoor cafe-like setting, smiling warmly at each other with foam visible on the surface. (4) The women are outside on a wide ski slope, wearing full winter gear and goggles, looking at the camera with a clear blue sky and distant mountains behind them. (5) Back indoors, a close-up shows the two friends clinking their beer mugs. (6) A woman in a pink ski jacket and a white bear-eared fluffy hat dances playfully in a snowy field surrounded by pine trees covered in thick snow. (7) She walks along a snowy path wearing a light blue knitted sweater and white earmuffs, looking back over her shoulder with a joyful expression. (8) A wide landscape shot from a moving ski lift showing the vast snowy mountain range, chairlifts, and a valley below under a bright sun. (9) A woman snowboards down a sunlit groomed slope, carving through the snow and creating visible sprays as the sun sets, casting long shadows across the white terrain.
